title: Weekend Preview: Zags Meet LSU, Mendoza's Debut vs. the Hawks, Huskies Chase Six
description: The Zags host 3-0 LSU at the Spokane Arena. The Seahawks and Drew Lock face No. 1 pick Fernando Mendoza in his first NFL start. The Huskies need one win at Michigan State for bowl eligibility. Plus the new playoff rankings and the trade deadline.

title: Weekend Recap: Zags Roll, Lock Delivers, Huskies Fall Just Short
description: The Zags beat New Mexico State 109-68 with three 20-point scorers. Drew Lock and the defense beat Arizona 17-3. The Huskies' second-half rally comes up three points short against Penn State. Plus Arozarena's qualifying offer, Miami's first loss and the NFL trade deadline.

title: Weekend Preview: Zags Finally Beat Purdue, Lock Steps In, Huskies Chase a Bowl
description: The Zags beat Purdue for the first time ever. The Seahawks regroup after a 34-17 loss to the Bears with Drew Lock starting for the injured Sam Darnold against Arizona. The Huskies can clinch bowl eligibility against Penn State, plus new Mariners manager Jason Kanzler and the first CFP rankings.

title: Weekend Recap: Huskies Steal One in Lincoln, Zags and Hawks Go Monday
description: The Huskies beat Nebraska 17-10 on two late scores. Plus previews of the Zags' opener against Purdue and Seahawks-Bears on Monday night, the Mariners' manager search, USC's upset of Ohio State and the rest of a wild weekend.

title: Pilot: Halloween Weekend Preview
description: Cal and Rusty preview Huskies at Nebraska, Gonzaga's opener against Purdue in Vegas, and Seahawks-Bears on Monday night, plus the Quenton Nelson trade, the Mariners' manager search, the Brewers' title and more.
